crusadecraft.style.label: Style: %s
crusadecraft.style.tip: The style of this realm's built cities: the packs its buildings come from (MineColonies, Byzantine). Click for the next one, Shift+click to go back.
crusadecraft.style.set.missing: %s will build in the %s style, but no pack of that style is installed: its cities will keep the mod's own plans.
crusadecraft.town.started: %s takes shape: a %s in the %s style. Building starts as soon as the area is loaded.
crusadecraft.town.exists: This city is already built, or being built.
crusadecraft.town.no_pack: No pack of this style is installed, or it has no town hall: nothing to build.
crusadecraft.town.not_a_town: This is not a city built from plans.
crusadecraft.town.undone: %s is being undone: the land comes back, block by block. The city stays on the map.
crusadecraft.town.build.tip: Build this city for real, at once, with the buildings of its realm's style: town hall, houses, tavern, streets… Its size follows its population. Every block is recorded: it can be undone. Click twice to confirm.
crusadecraft.town.state.tip: A built city is managed from its construction on the map ("Village of …"): that is where you undo it.
crusadecraft.town.undo.tip: Put the land back as it was before the city, block by block (chests included). Its inhabitants leave; the city stays on the map. Click twice to confirm.
crusadecraft.plan.empty.files: No file yet. Drop your .nbt (structure block) and .schem (WorldEdit) plans in the folder shown below, then reopen the catalogue.
crusadecraft.plan.tooltip.none: No plan chosen: right-click in the air to open the catalogue.
crusadecraft.plan.tooltip.1: Right-click in the air: the catalogue
crusadecraft.plan.tooltip.2: Right-click a block: place, ground level with the block
crusadecraft.plan.denied: The Architect's Plan is for creative mode and map editors only.
crusadecraft.plan.chosen: Plan chosen: %s (%s × %s × %s). The frame shows where it will land.
crusadecraft.plan.chosen.town: Chosen: %s, %s buildings. The frame shows its footprint.
crusadecraft.plan.pasting: Placing %s… To undo it: /crusade plan annuler
crusadecraft.plan.undone: Your last placement is being undone, block by block.
crusadecraft.codex.plans: Built cities and the Architect's Plan
crusadecraft.codex.plans.p0: Each computer realm has a $(l)style$(): European, Chinese, Japanese, Egyptian, Roman or Nordic. Its buildings come from the installed MineColonies and Byzantine packs, read during play.$(br2)In the map editor: "Style" on the realm, then "$(l)Build the city$()" on one of its cities.
crusadecraft.codex.plans.p1: The city rises at once: town hall, square, houses, tavern, farms… according to its population, with its streets and inhabitants. "$(l)Undo the city$()" gives the land back block by block.$(br2)Setting $(l)villesIA$(): computer cities take shape when you come near (off by default).
crusadecraft.codex.plans.p2: The $(l)Architect's Plan$() (creative): right-click in the air for the catalogue (whole cities, style packs, your .nbt and .schem files), right-click a block to place, sneak to turn.$(br2)$(l)/crusade plan annuler$() undoes the last placement.
